{{Quote|Her mother Tema was known for her spirit. She was one of the few to leave us. She was restless and wanted to see the world outside. But she returned. Hill people always return.|Tema|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown" />}}
'''Tema''' was a member of the [[Hill people]] who lived on [[Gala]]. She was the mother of [[Elan Tallah|Elan]], the leader of the Hill People. Tema left the Hill People to go to [[Galu]], the capital city of Gala, to see the world outside. She was an artisan and heard that the palace needed workers. However, she later returned to the mountains, never speaking of her experiences there.<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown" />
